ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, point B is a point on line segment AC, and $AB=21$, $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$. Calculate the length of line segment AC.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal line segment, the left endpoint is labeled A, the right endpoint is labeled C, and point B is located on line segment AC, between A and C; the figure also labels point O, but it does not affect the calculation of this problem. Therefore line segment AC can be regarded as being composed of the two segments AB and BC added together. Reasoning: It is known that AB = 21, and BC = \frac{1}{3}AB, so BC = \frac{1}{3} \times 21 = 7. Thus AC = AB + BC = 21 + 7 = 28. Final answer: 28.
